typed_links.link: The book's own contrast pair fixes the standard: 13:34 opens with wayyiqtol vayyivrach Avshalom (narrative chain, no boundary force) while 13:37/38 twice write genuine fronted ve'Avshalom barach (disjunctive). No wayyiqtol may be labeled 'disjunctive'; the class correction governs M8-2Sam-009, 010, 011, 013, 062, 068, 076, 077, 089, 101, 102 (rejected-alternative), 133, 134 — rationale rewrites only, every span and (except 033's separate ruling) every confidence unchanged, because each boundary rests on independent tier-1 evidence.

Rows must cite what the quoted witness actually prints and disclose WEB/MT divergence rather than harmonize from Chronicles: 139 deleted 'Pas Dammim' outright (absent from BOTH witnesses; imported from 1 Chr 11:13); 136 keeps WEB's 'Goliath the Gittite's brother' as a WEB citation while disclosing MT reads et Golyat haggitti without 'brother' (WEB harmonizes toward 1 Chr 20:5); 134 likewise disclosed the 21:8 Merab(WEB)/Michal(MT) crux without harmonizing.
Inside WEB 18:33-19:43 = MT 19:1-19:44 every row must declare the +1 MT rule in-row and qualify every verse number as WEB or MT; 116 is the model; the amendment governs 115, 117, 118, 121, 122.

'Inclusio' may be claimed only when both members lie inside the span; cross-boundary echoes are relabeled (internal repetition, long-range lexical echo, or Wiederaufnahme). Governs 003 (anointed-of-Yahweh internal echo), 051 (table refrain long-range echo to 9:7), 086 (14:24/14:28 resumptive repetition — first member sits in 084's span).

The two officer registers (8:15-18; 20:23-26) form the court narrative's bracketing pair; both rows now render kohen/kohanim uniformly per the lexeme-consistency ruling so their own recension arguments (David's sons as kohanim vs Ira the Jairite; Adoram's forced-labor portfolio) are visible, and each row's rationale names the other as its counterpart. Evidence-level relation only; both spans unchanged.

Both-edges-independently-grounded test applied strictly: 033 downgraded high→medium (5:13 near edge is a plain wayyiqtol; the register formula only arrives at 5:14, so the 3:2/3:5 inclusio analogy fails), while 029 stays high (the 5:1/5:3 doubled assembly is an internal explanatory gap, not an edge defect).
